question: 单项选择：I don't know _____ he will come or not. A. that  B. if  C. what  D. where
用所给词的适当形式填空：She asked me ______ (if/whether) I could help her.
单项选择：Could you tell me _____ there is a bank nearby? A. that  B. if  C. what  D. where
answer: 答案：B. if。解析：if"是否"，问是否有银行。

question: 单项选择：I wonder _____ he is at home now. A. that  B. if  C. what  D. who
翻译句子：他问我是否想去看电影。
answer: 答案：He asked me if/whether I wanted to go to the movies. 解析：if/whether"是否"。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：I don't know ______ (whether) he will agree with us.
answer: 答案：whether。解析：whether/if都可表示"是否"。

question: 单项选择：_____ he will come is not clear. A. If  B. Whether  C. That  D. What
answer: 答案：B. Whether。解析：在句首只用whether。

question: 单项选择：It depends on _____ he will come. A. that  B. if  C. whether  D. what
answer: 答案：C. whether。解析：介词后只用whether。

question: 翻译句子：我想知道他是否会来。
answer: 答案：I wonder if/whether he will come. 解析：if/whether"是否"。wonder后接if/whether从句。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：I'm not sure ______ (if/whether) he is right.
